verses.text: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus through God will, to di saints wey dey Ephesus, and di faithful for Christ Jesus:
Grace to una and peace from God our Papa and di Lord Jesus Christ.
Blessed be di God and Papa of our Lord Jesus Christ, wey don bless us with every spiritual blessing for di heavenly places for Christ;
even as e choose us for am before di foundation of di world, so that we go holy and without blemish before am for love;
as e don plan before to adopt us as pikin dem through Jesus Christ to imself, according to di good pleasure of im desire,
to di praise of di glory of im grace, by which e freely give us favor for di Beloved.
For am we get our redemption through im blood, di forgiveness of our trespasses, according to di riches of im grace,
wey e make abound towards us for all wisdom and prudence,
dey make known to us di mystery of im will, according to im good pleasure wey e purpose for am
to administration of di fullness of di times, to sum up all things for Christ, di things for di heavens, and di things for di earth, for am;
for whom we get inheritance too, as dem don appoint us before according to di purpose of di one wey dey work all things after di plan of im will;
so that we go be to di praise of im glory, we wey don hope for Christ before:
for whom una too, as una don hear di word of di truth, di Good News of una salvation—for whom, as una don believe too, dem seal una with di Holy Spirit of promise,
wey be pledge of our inheritance, to di redemption of God own possession, to di praise of im glory.
For this reason I too, as I don hear of di faith for di Lord Jesus wey dey among una, and di love wey una get towards all di saints,
no dey stop to give thanks for una, dey mention una for my prayers;
so that di God of our Lord Jesus Christ, di Papa of glory, go give una spirit of wisdom and revelation for di knowledge of am;
as di eyes of una hearts don dey enlightened, so that una go know wetin be di hope of im calling, wetin be di riches of di glory of im inheritance for di saints,
and wetin be di exceeding greatness of im power towards us wey believe, according to that working of di strength of im might
wey e work for Christ, when e raise am from di dead, and make am sit for im right hand for di heavenly places,
far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name wey dem name, no only for this age, but for di one wey go come too.
E put all things under im feet, and give am to be head over all things for di assembly,
wey be im body, di fullness of di one wey dey fill all inside all.
Una dey dead for transgressions and sins, den dem make una alive,
for which una waka before according to di course of this world, according to di prince of di power of di air, di spirit wey dey work now inside di pikin dem of disobedience;
among whom we all live before too for di lusts of our flesh, dey do di desires of di flesh and of di mind, and we be by nature pikin dem of wrath, even as di rest.
But God, as e rich for mercy, for im great love wey e love us with,
even when we dey dead through our trespasses, make us alive together with Christ—by grace dem don save una—
and raise us up with am, and make us sit with am for di heavenly places for Christ Jesus,
so that for di ages wey dey come e go show di exceeding riches of im grace for kindness towards us for Christ Jesus;
because by grace dem don save una through faith, and that no be of yourselves; na God gift,
no be of works, so that nobody go boast.
Because we be im workmanship, wey dem create for Christ Jesus for good works, wey God prepare before so that we go waka for dem.
So remember say una once, di Gentiles for di flesh, wey dem call uncircumcision by those wey dem call circumcision, for di flesh, wey dem make by hands;
say for that time una separate from Christ, alienated from di commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from di covenants of di promise, no get hope and without God for di world.
But now for Christ Jesus una wey dey far before don near for di blood of Christ.
Because na im be our peace, wey make both one, and break down di middle wall of separation,
as e don abolish for di flesh di hostility, di law of commandments wey dey inside ordinances, so that e go create for imself one new man from di two, dey make peace;
and so that e go reconcile dem both for one body to God through di cross, as e don kill di hostility by am.
E come preach peace to una wey dey far and peace to di people wey dey near.
Because through am we both get our access for one Spirit to Papa God.
So den una no be strangers and foreigners again, but una be fellow citizens with di saints, and of di household of God,
as dem don build una on di foundation of di apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus imself na di chief cornerstone;
for whom di whole building, as dem fit am together, dey grow into holy temple for di Lord;
for whom una too dem dey build together for place where God go dey live for di Spirit.
For this reason I, Paul, na di prisoner of Christ Jesus for behalf of una Gentiles,
if e be say una don hear of di administration of that grace of God wey dem give me towards una;
how by revelation dem make di mystery known to me, as I write before for few words,
by which, when una read, una fit perceive my understanding for di mystery of Christ;
wey for other generations dem no make known to di children of men, as dem don reveal am now to im holy apostles and prophets for di Spirit;
say di Gentiles na fellow heirs, and fellow members of di body, and fellow partakers of im promise for Christ Jesus through di Good News,
wey I become servant of according to di gift of that grace of God wey dem give me according to di working of im power.
To me, di very least of all saints, dem give this grace, to preach to di Gentiles di riches of Christ wey no fit dem search out,
and to make all men see wetin be di administration of di mystery wey don hide for God for ages, wey create all things through Jesus Christ;
so that now through di assembly di many-sided wisdom of God go dey made known to di principalities and di powers for di heavenly places,
according to di eternal purpose wey e accomplish for Christ Jesus our Lord;
for whom we get boldness and access with confidence through our faith for am.
So I ask say una no go lose heart for my troubles for una, wey be una glory.
For this reason I bow my knees to di Papa of our Lord Jesus Christ,
from whom every family for heaven and for earth dey take name,
say e go grant una, according to di riches of im glory, say una go dey strengthened with power through im Spirit for di inward man;
say Christ go dwell for una hearts through faith; so that una, as una dey rooted and grounded for love,
go dey strong to comprehend with all di saints wetin be di breadth and length and height and depth,
and to know Christ love wey pass knowledge, so that una go full with all di fullness of God.
Now to di one wey fit do well well pass all wey we ask or think, according to di power wey dey work inside us,
to am make glory dey for di assembly and for Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
So I, di prisoner for di Lord, beg una to waka worthy of di calling wey dem call una with,
with all humility and gentleness, with patience, dey bear with each other for love;
dey eager to keep di unity of di Spirit for di bond of peace.
One body dey, and one Spirit, even as dem call una for one hope of una calling;
one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
one God and Papa of all, wey dey over all, through all, and for all.
But to each one of us dem give grace according to di measure of di gift of Christ.
So e talk, “When e go up on high, e lead captivity captive, and give gifts to men.”
Now this, “E go up”, wetin e be except say e go down first enter di lower parts of di earth too?
Di one wey go down na di one wey go up too far above all di heavens, so that e go fill all things.
E give some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
for di perfecting of di saints, to di work of serving, to di building up of di body of Christ;
until we all reach di unity of di faith, and of di knowledge of God Pikin, to full grown man, to di measure of di stature of di fullness of Christ;
so that we no go be pikin dem again, wey dem toss back and forth and carry about with every wind of doctrine, by di trick of men, for craftiness, after di wiles of error;
but as we dey talk truth for love, we go grow up for all things into am, wey be di head, Christ;

from whom all di body, as dem fit am and join am together through wetin every joint supply, according to di working for proper measure of each individual part, dey make di body increase to di building up of itself for love.
So I talk this, and testify for di Lord, say una no go waka again like di rest of di Gentiles dey waka, for di vanity of dem mind,
as dem darken for dem understanding, alienated from di life of God, because of di ignorance wey dey inside dem, because of di hardening of dem hearts;
wey, as dem don become callous, give demself up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
But una no learn Christ that way;
if truly una hear am, and dem teach una inside am, even as truth dey for Jesus:
say una put away, about una former way of life, di old man, wey dey grow corrupt after di lusts of deceit;
and say dem renew una for di spirit of una mind,
and put on di new man, wey dem create for di likeness of God for righteousness and holiness of di truth.
So as una dey put away falsehood, talk truth each one with im neighbor. Because we be members of each other.
“Dey angry, and no sin.” No let di sun go down on una wrath,
and no give place to di devil.
Make di one wey steal no steal again; but rather make e labor, dey produce with im hands something wey good, so that e go get something to give to di one wey need.
No let any corrupt speech come out of una mouth, but only wetin good for building others up as need fit be, so that e go give grace to di people wey hear.
No grieve di Holy Spirit of God, for whom dem seal una for di day of redemption.
Make dem put away all bitterness, wrath, anger, clamor, and slander from una, with all malice.
And dey kind to each other, tenderhearted, dey forgive each other, just as God for Christ forgive una too.
So imitate God, as beloved pikin dem.
Waka for love, even as Christ love una too, and give imself up for us, offering and sacrifice to God for sweet-smelling fragrance.
But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or greed, make dem no even mention am among una, as e suit saints;
or filthiness, or foolish talking, or jesting, wey no suitable; but rather giving of thanks.
Because know this, say no sexually immoral person, or unclean person, or greedy man, wey be idolater, get any inheritance for di Kingdom of Christ and God.
Make nobody deceive una with empty words. Because of these things, God wrath dey come on di pikin dem of disobedience.
So no be partakers with dem.
Because una be darkness before, but now una be light for di Lord. Waka as pikin dem of light,
because di fruit of di Spirit dey for all goodness and righteousness and truth,
dey prove wetin well-pleasing to di Lord.
No get fellowship with di unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove dem.
Because e shame even to talk about di things wey dem dey do for secret.
But all things, when dem reprove dem, di light dey reveal dem, because everything wey dem reveal na light.
So e talk, “Wake up, you wey dey sleep, and rise from di dead, and Christ go shine on you.”
So watch carefully how una dey waka, no as unwise, but as wise;
dey redeem di time, because di days evil.
So no dey foolish, but understand wetin be di Lord will.
No dey drunk with wine, wey dey lead to wasteful living, but make di Spirit full una,
dey talk to each other for psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; dey sing and dey sing praises for una heart to di Lord;
dey give thanks always about all things for di name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even Papa God;
dey subject yourselves to each other for di fear of Christ.
Wives, dey subject to una own husbands, as to di Lord.
Because di husband na di head of di wife, as Christ too na di head of di assembly, as e imself be di savior of di body.
But as di assembly dey subject to Christ, so make di wives dey to dem own husbands for everything.
Husbands, love una wives, even as Christ love di assembly too, and give imself up for am;
so that e go make am holy, as e don clean am by di washing of water with di word,
so that e go present di assembly to imself gloriously, no get spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but say e go holy and without blemish.
Na so too husbands suppose love dem own wives as dem own bodies. Di one wey love im own wife dey love imself.
Because nobody ever hate im own flesh, but e dey nourish and cherish am, even as di Lord dey do to di assembly too;
because we be members of im body, of im flesh and bones.
“For this reason man go leave im papa and mama, and go join im wife. Di two go become one flesh.”
This mystery great, but I dey talk about Christ and di assembly.
Still, each one of una must love im own wife even as imself, and make di wife see say e respect im husband.
Pikin dem, obey una parents for di Lord, because this dey right.
“Honor your papa and mama,” wey be di first commandment with promise:
“so that e go well with you, and you go live long for di earth.”
Una fathers, no provoke una pikin dem to wrath, but train dem for di discipline and instruction of di Lord.
Servants, obey di people wey according to di flesh na una masters, with fear and trembling, with single heart, as to Christ;
no for di way of service only when eyes dey on una, as men-pleasers; but as servants of Christ, dey do God will from di heart;
dey do service with good will, as to di Lord, and no to men;
as una know say whatever good thing each one do, e go receive di same from di Lord, whether e be slave or free.
Una masters, do di same things to dem, and stop threatening, as una know say di one wey be both dem Master and una own dey heaven, and no partiality dey with am.
Finally, brothers, strong for di Lord, and for di strength of im might.
Put on di whole armor of God, so that una go fit stand against di wiles of di devil.

Because our wrestling no be against flesh and blood, but against di principalities, against di powers, against di world rulers of di darkness of this age, and against di spiritual forces of wickedness for di heavenly places.
So put on di whole armor of God, so that una go fit withstand for di evil day, and as una don do all, to stand.
So stand, as una don buckle di belt of truth round una waist, and don put on di breastplate of righteousness,
and don fit una feet with di preparation of di Good News of peace;
above all, take up di shield of faith, wey una go fit quench all di fiery darts of di evil one.
And take di helmet of salvation, and di sword of di Spirit, wey be di word of God;
with all prayer and requests dey pray at all times for di Spirit, and dey watchful to this end with all perseverance and requests for all di saints:
for my behalf, so that dem go give me utterance as I open my mouth, to make known with boldness di mystery of di Good News,
wey I be ambassador for chains for; so that for am I go talk boldly, as I suppose talk.
But so that una too go know my affairs, how I dey, Tychicus, di beloved brother and faithful servant for di Lord, go make known to una all things.
I don send am to una for this very purpose, so that una go know our state, and so that e go comfort una hearts.
Peace dey with di brothers, and love with faith, from God Papa and di Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace dey with all di people wey love our Lord Jesus Christ with love wey no dey decay. Amen.
